items.name: Punjabi Samosa
items.description: Two fat, flaky parcels packed with spiced potato and green peas, fried to a deep amber. Served with tamarind chutney and a scatter of chaat masala.

items.name: Paneer Pakora
items.description: Thick slices of fresh paneer in a gram-flour batter with ajwain and cracked pepper. Golden outside, still soft in the middle, with mint chutney for dipping.

items.name: Dahi ke Kebab
items.description: Hung curd, roasted cashew and green chilli, set and pan-seared until the outside barely holds. They collapse the moment you bite. Pomegranate and mint on top.

items.name: Amritsari Fish Fry
items.description: River fish in a gram-flour and carom-seed crust, fried hot and fast so the edges shatter. Lemon, raw onion rings, and a green chutney sharp with coriander.

items.name: Chicken 65
items.description: Bites of chicken in a chilli-red yoghurt marinade, flash-fried and tossed with curry leaves, dried red chillies and a spoon of cool yoghurt to calm it down.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Paneer cubes in a hung-curd and kashmiri chilli marinade, skewered with peppers and onion, and left in the tandoor until the edges blacken.

items.name: Tandoori Chicken
items.description: Half a chicken, scored deep, marinated overnight in yoghurt, ginger and deggi mirch, then charred in the tandoor. Smoky all the way to the bone.

items.name: Chicken Tikka
items.description: Boneless thigh in a double marinade — ginger-garlic first, then yoghurt and spice — skewered and blistered. Six pieces, a lemon wedge, and nothing else needed.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tandoori chicken folded into a tomato gravy that has been simmering since morning, finished with cream and crushed kasuri methi. Rich, faintly sweet, impossible to stop.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.description: Whole black urad lentils, soaked overnight and cooked low for six hours with butter and a little smoke. The one dish our kitchen will not rush.

items.name: Paneer Butter Masala
items.description: Soft paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy with a slow bloom of red chilli, a swirl of cream and a tangle of ginger julienne on top.

items.name: Palak Paneer
items.description: Spinach blanched and ground coarse — never blended smooth — with garlic, green chilli and a little cream, holding cubes of paneer that stay white against the green.

items.name: Malai Kofta
items.description: Paneer and potato dumplings with cashew and raisin at the centre, fried gently and laid in a pale, faintly sweet cream gravy. Soft enough to cut with a spoon.

items.name: Kadai Chicken
items.description: Chicken cooked hot and dry in an iron karahi with onion, tomato, green chilli and coarsely crushed coriander seed. Loud, peppery, and best with roti.

items.name: Rogan Josh
items.description: Lamb shoulder braised until it gives way, in a Kashmiri gravy of dried red chilli, fennel and asafoetida. The heat arrives late and stays a while.

items.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
items.description: Layered raw-dum biryani — marinated chicken at the bottom, half-cooked basmati with saffron milk on top, sealed and finished on low heat. Served with mirchi ka salan and raita.

items.name: Mutton Biryani
items.description: The same dum method, with mutton on the bone so the rice takes on everything. Long grain, separate and stained orange in places. Fried onion and mint throughout.

items.name: Garlic Butter Naan
items.description: Stretched by hand and slapped onto the clay wall of the tandoor. Brushed with garlic butter the second it comes out, so it arrives glossy and blistered.

items.name: Tandoori Roti
items.description: Whole wheat, no yeast, cooked until it puffs and spots. Plain and sturdy — the right thing to have under a gravy that deserves it.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.description: Three warm dumplings of reduced milk, fried dark and left to drink up cardamom and rose syrup until they are almost too soft to lift.

items.name: Rasmalai
items.description: Flat discs of fresh chenna poached in milk, then chilled in saffron and cardamom cream with pistachio and almond scattered over. Cold, soft, faintly floral.

items.name: Gajar ka Halwa
items.description: Grated carrot cooked down in milk and ghee for a long time, until it turns deep orange and jammy. Finished with khoya, cashew and a little cardamom.

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Assam leaf boiled hard with milk, ginger, green cardamom and clove. Poured from a height into a small glass, the way it should be.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.description: Alphonso pulp and thick curd, whisked with a pinch of cardamom and served over ice. Cold enough to put out a chilli-based fire.
